{{Quote|Not for the faint of heart! This zesty slider features a patty topped with mouthwatering Zeltron pop-peppers, pink lettuce, magenta onions and spicy "pleasure planet" sauce. |Dex's Diner menu, on the Zeltros slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Zeltros sliders''' were a type of spicy [[slider]] sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 6.7 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> The [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] was inspired by the travels of the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]], [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], and was named for [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]],<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />  a planet located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="Atlas" /> The slider consisted of a blackened [[Limb/Legends|hand]]-formed [[Mongo Beefhead patty]], [[magenta onion]]s, [[pink lettuce]], [[Zeltron pop-pepper]]s, and spicy [["Pleasure planet" sauce|"pleasure planet" sauce]], all served on a [[medium-density food-board]] with the diner's [[Slider garnish|special garnish]]. The diner offered [[Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup]] and [[Bimm mustard]] free of charge for the slider upon request. A Zeltros slider could also be bought alongside another basic slider as a [[Talus and Tralus slider]] meal for 9.7 credits.<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zeltros sliders were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
